title: Disco
tagline: Orchestral strings, steady four-on-the-floor beats, and communal release.
summary: Disco grew from Black, Latino, and LGBTQ+ dance-floor cultures in the United States during the 1970s. Orchestral arrangements, steady beats, and extended mixes made the music central to club life. Its production techniques shaped house, dance-pop, and modern electronic music long after disco's initial chart era.
origin_place: New York City and Philadelphia, United States

pillars.name: Donna Summer
pillars.why: Summer's recordings with producer Giorgio Moroder connected disco to electronic sequencing and expansive club arrangements.

pillars.name: Chic
pillars.why: Chic's precise rhythm guitar and elegant production became a defining template for disco and dance music.

pillars.name: Gloria Gaynor
pillars.why: Gaynor's powerful vocals and enduring dance-floor recordings made her one of disco's best-known performers.
